chunks.text: From: P. Srinivas Rao <srinivas@godavaripack.example> To: Meera Raghunathan <meera.raghunathan@sahyadricp.example> Cc: purchase.hyd@sahyadricp.example Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 18:47:12 +0530 Subject: RE: RFQ SCPL/PKG/RFQ/2026-27/014 - Corrugated boxes - our rates
Dear Madam,
Greetings from Godavari Packaging.
Thank you for the enquiry. Sorry for the delay, we were waiting for the revised kraft rates from the mill. Please find our rates below. All rates are per kg of box weight, GST extra.

- 3-ply plain brown boxes: Rs 44/kg - 5-ply plain: Rs 46/kg (RSC and the big HSC box). For the heavy duty BF22 jam box add Rs 3/kg. - Printed ones Rs 5/kg extra over plain, up to 2 colours - so the 1 & 2 colour 3-ply boxes and the 2 colour 5-ply shampoo box (CP-010). - Partitions and layer pads (CP-020 to CP-024): Rs 41/kg.
For the trays and inserts we are already supplying to your Hyderabad plant, remaining items same as last year's pricing.

The 3-colour box CP-011 we cannot do (2 colour max), and the water resistant one CP-012 also we don't have coating facility. Other die-cut items (gift box, mailer, hand-hole box), the sleeve, export and 7 ply items we are not quoting this time.

Terms: Freight extra. MOQ 5,000 for printed boxes. Below that small run charges will apply. Payment 30 days. Delivery 10 days from PO. Rates hold till December end. Rates are based on current kraft price, if kraft goes up more than 5% we will have to pass on.

Your technical questionnaire - our replies: 1. Yes, ISO 9001:2015, cert valid till Aug 2027 (copy attached). 2. No FSC. 3. Yes, 70%+ recycled on all our grades, declaration can be given. 4. 9,000 MT/yr, running about 70%. 5. In-house lab – GSM, BS, ECT, BCT, moisture & Cobb every lot, COA sent with each vehicle. 6. Lot code stamped on every box. 7. Lead time 10 days. 8. We respond within 48 hrs, CAPA in 7 days. 9. Bollaram & Medchal, both within 40 km of your Patancheru plant. 10. Yes – Medchal unit as backup, 20 days paper stock, buying from 3 mills. 11. No water-resistant coating facility. 12. Flexo up to 2 colours only. 13. Waste recycling, no ISO 14001. 14. Pest control contract + GMP, no certification.
We have been supplying your Hyderabad plant for 5 years without any major complaint and request you to consider us for the Hyderabad and other requirements.
Regards, P. Srinivas Rao Partner, Godavari Packaging Works Plot 118, IDA Bollaram, Sangareddy Dist., Telangana 502325 Mob: 98490 77312
